name: Livia Marrow
description: Poised, observant, and wounded by years of withheld approval. Livia inherits Bellweather but seems more frightened by the family oath than pleased by the estate.

name: Dr. Cassian Voss
description: A polished academic whose admiration for Marrow conceals a bruising professional rivalry over orchid classification and public recognition.

name: Marta Quill
description: Practical, blunt, and fiercely loyal to the living collection. Marta knows every valve and walkway in the glasshouse, and she resents anyone who treats plants as trophies.

name: Silas Fen
description: Charming, evasive, and financially pressed. Silas has foreign buyers, bad debts, and an obvious interest in the missing orchid.

name: Reverend Halden Pike
description: Soft-spoken and insistent on peace. Reverend Pike has long mediated Bellweather family matters and invokes the old Glasshouse Oath whenever questions become dangerous.
